They get glowing violet hard-light armour and a blade or bow and fight for you: aim at a creature as you link to send them all after it, otherwise they go for whatever hurts you or whatever you hit. Let go once it is built: it flies out over the marker and airbursts, burning out a crater 40 to 80 blocks across. It hurts nobody, but its yellow gas drives every mob in reach into a Fear Frenzy: they kill each other with yellow construct weapons. Costs 90% of a full ring, down to 75% at full fear; more fear, bigger crater

It is still his, so it all fades back into orange light (40%)
